title: How it was tested
summary: tests/test_mailbox_bounds.rex reproduces the lane: one 40,000-byte report then 16 small requests. It checks the default limit, total, hasMore and nextAfterId; the 1500-byte cut and bodyBytes; that the listing JSON is under 30,000 characters, and also for twelve 40,000-byte requests with 1,000-byte subjects; afterId paging returns all 17 exactly once in order; newestFirst; maxBodyBytes 0; rejection of limit 0, 101, 2.5 and ten; get paging rebuilds the 40,000 bytes exactly; get leaves requests unread, hides them from other principals and rejects bad IDs and ranges; UTF-8 cuts (e-acute C3A9, Euro E282AC) never split a character and a 2-byte page over 3-byte characters still advances; and tools/list plus tools/call over MCP for both the dotted and compatibility names. Full suite: 11 PASS, test_gopher_sphere_checker SKIP (needs a live Gopher roll-up, as in v0.2-dev8). Autobuild run 20261126T020210Z-f2bc1e47c1de-ed6fdfb4 PASS, using tests/autobuild_run.sh, which builds the Foreign Runtime native library in a temporary copy.
authority: architecture Tom Dyer ("you need to fix that then", 26 Nov 2026 01:53); base v0.2-dev8 by ChatGPT; v0.2-dev9 change coded and written by Claude (Opus 5.5)
invariants: The regression reproduces the field case
procedure: bash tests/autobuild_run.sh with the six *_HOME variables set as in integration.json
